bayts.text: Allah made Iblīs despair of (seducing) me at Djéwol (Jéwol), when I called upon Him with “O Protector (Al-Walī)”.
Allah banished toward others than me, already before, at Ndar (Saint-Louis), through the people of Badr, the lions, my distress.
Allah banished toward others than me, at Dakar, every harm that a schemer had dragged toward me.
The All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān) taught me, on the ship, that I am the servant of him (who rests) in Medina.
Allah kept me clear, at Conakry, of everything that drags toward reprehensible deeds.
Allah removed from me at Grand-Bassam, already before, my challenger, and from me the deceiver.
The Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm) called me to Himself at Dāwum (Dahomey), with that which frees from all bargaining.
He Who led to me what remained hidden from every saint made my aspirations easy for me at Libreville.
He Who removed the slanderer and the envier has led to me the people of Badr, the lions.
Allah leads to me, wherever I am, the glad tidings of “There is no god but Allah”.
Allah drove toward others than me, at Mayumba, what grieved my heart, and raised (my) side.
To Allah I arrived at Kalwā (in Gabon), and He guarded me from what drags in affliction.
My writing, already before, by the seas, guarded my life from the wiles of the Rejected One (Satan).
The All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm) taught me, by the brimming (waters), what He wills, and spared me the disbelieving (powers).
There did not come toward me, by the drowning seas, any who invites to wine, nor the invitations of depraved (women).
The Beautiful (Al-Jamīl) made easy for me, amid deadly trials, what kept me from whoever draws toward idolatrous (women).
The gifts of Him Who was for me by the vast (expanses) have led to my breast good pleasure and radiant (lights).
He Who spared me the blows extended lights to me, amid the darkness and the wrongdoers.
My felicity with God, Allah, became manifest to me among the people of (frivolous) amusements.
Nothing came toward me, among the people of wines, but the good pleasure of an Everlasting One to Whom (belong) my affairs.
Allah purified me, among the People of the Book, of (spiritual) wretchedness and of every reproach.
He Who led me to Himself with understanding honoured me among the associators.
I called upon Him intimately with “O Helper (An-Naṣīr), O Protector (Al-Walī), You spared me Iblīs at Djéwol”.
